ZAF.scope: South African central government only (State Revenue Account), 1990/91 actual, Budget Review 1993 Table 4.2; R2.59 per US$. Rates and brackets approximate.

mechs.name: Individual income tax
mechs.note: Normal tax on individuals' taxable income, 1990/91 actual. Progressive schedule from about 17% to a top marginal rate of about 44% (bracket limits approximate, from memory); rebates and deductions folded into the standard deduction. Includes PAYE and provisional payments, net of refunds.

mechs.name: Company tax (non-mining)
mechs.note: Normal tax on non-mining company profits, 1990/91 actual. Rate 48% in 1990/91 (the 1993 Budget Review shows it still 48% in 1993, proposed 40%); plus a secondary tax on companies, folded in here.

mechs.name: Gold mining tax
mechs.note: Income tax on gold mines under the special gold-mining formula (rate falls as profit margin rises); amount is volatile with the gold price. Rate shown is an approximation.

mechs.name: Other mining tax
mechs.note: Income tax on non-gold mines (coal, platinum, diamonds etc.). Rate shown is an approximation.

mechs.name: General sales tax (GST)
mechs.note: Single-stage general sales tax in force until September 1991 (VAT replaced it). Doc says it ran at 13% in 1990/91; amount is the Inland Revenue figure for sales tax, net of refunds.

mechs.name: Gold mining leases
mechs.note: Lease consideration paid by gold mines to the state on mineral rights.

mechs.name: Non-resident shareholders' tax
mechs.note: Withholding tax on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders (15% in 1990).

mechs.name: Stamp duties and fees
mechs.note: Stamp duties on documents and transactions plus fees of office.

mechs.name: Transfer duty
mechs.note: Duty on transfers of immovable property, payable by the buyer.

mechs.name: Interest and dividends
mechs.note: Interest and dividends received by the state revenue account.

mechs.name: Other inland revenue
mechs.note: Remaining inland revenue: donations tax, estate duty, levies and miscellaneous receipts.

mechs.name: Customs duty
mechs.note: Import duties under the customs tariff, 1990/91 actual, gross of the Customs Union payments below.

mechs.name: Import surcharge
mechs.note: Temporary surcharge on imports, levied on top of customs duty (introduced 1985, reduced in later years).

mechs.name: Excise duty
mechs.note: Excise on alcoholic and tobacco products, motor vehicles and other locally produced goods, gross of Customs Union payments.

mechs.name: Fuel levy
mechs.note: Road-fuel levy on petrol and diesel, introduced 1987, raised steadily and earmarked broadly for roads and the strategic fuel account.

mechs.name: Miscellaneous customs and excise
mechs.note: Miscellaneous receipts of Customs and Excise.

mechs.name: Customs Union Agreement payments
mechs.note: Customs and excise revenue paid over to Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia and Swaziland under the Southern African Customs Union formula (negative: offsets the gross customs and excise lines).

mechs.name: Namibia: Central Revenue Fund
mechs.note: Final transfer of customs and excise revenue to Namibia's Central Revenue Fund before independence (March 1990); negative offset.
